name: Interval Trainer
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Ear-training and pitch-jump drill. The app plays a root note, then a target note an interval above it (m3, P5, octave...), then you sing the target back. A live tuner needle shows how close you are; hold it in tune to score. Where Scale Runner drills single notes, this drills the relationship between two - the foundation of singing in tune against accompaniment. Pick the interval pool (perfect intervals, thirds & fifths, or mixed) and the root note so it sits in your range.
